get.summary: Projects, sections, tasks and labels changed since a cursor (everything, without one)
get.description: Store the returned cursor and send it as `since` next time. Upsert rows by id (one may arrive twice), drop the ids in `deleted`, drop projects missing from `projectIds` (and their sections and tasks, except tasks assigned to you), and when `reset` is true, drop everything first. A full sync leaves out tasks completed more than 30 days ago.
